How teams form

Parents can register 1–4 students in one submission. Four students registered together automatically form a competition team. If you register fewer than four students, the organizer will help form a team.

Detailed round rules, the schedule, and the registration deadline will be announced here.

HOW TO JOIN

Three simple steps.

  1. 1

    Register your students

    Parents can register up to four students with one shared contact. Four students form a team automatically; the organizer helps smaller groups form a team.

  2. 2

    Save your reference

    Keep the registration reference shown after submission.

  3. 3

    Continue to the school

    Make payment on the school's donation page and keep its receipt.
